items.title: Qwen Sparse Attention fork of llama.cpp holds 185 tok/s at 255K context on one gaming GPU versus 82 for the stock dense build
items.summary: A community fork adds Qwen Sparse Attention to llama.cpp and ships GGUF weights for Qwen3.8-27B; the author's decode benchmark at 255K tokens of context is 185 tok/s with QSA against 82 on the stock dense build, with the harness published.

doubt.pushback: Single-author benchmark on one card; quality of the sparse-attention weights versus dense not reviewed.

items.title: Perplexity Decider v1.3 and Decider Flash v1.3 score 70 and 64 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2.1
items.summary: Artificial Analysis benchmarks Perplexity's updated decision models: Decider v1.3 ranks #4 on AA-Paperclip and #3 on EvalSafe-O*NET-AA, and Flash gains 4 points over v1.2, at about 68 and 34 dollars per million index tasks.

items.title: llama.cpp MoE expert cache gives no gain on an Apple-silicon Mac with experts offloaded (21.2 vs 21.4 tok/s)
items.summary: A first-hand test of the new llama.cpp MoE expert cache on an M5 Ultra with Qwen3.8 Flash Next shows 21.2 tok/s without it and 21.4 with it; the author explains unified memory leaves the cache nothing to save and says it targets discrete GPUs.

items.title: RTX Spark laptop on Linux drops from 80 to 39.5 TFLOP/s under sustained load; resending the power profile restores 73
items.summary: A report on an HP laptop with the RTX Spark chip traces a halving of GPU throughput on Linux to a power limit falling from 80W to 45W, and says re-sending HP's power profile every minute held 73 to 75 TFLOP/s; the linked NVIDIA driver issue has since withdrawn some of its clock and percent-of-peak claims.

doubt.pushback: The linked issue carries an update dated 2026-11-05 withdrawing its physical-clock conversion and percent-of-peak claims; the TFLOP/s and power-limit numbers are not confirmed independently.

items.title: Hermes Agent can resume a background subagent after a usage limit or restart, behind an opt-in setting
items.summary: A Hermes Agent update lets the gateway pick an interrupted background subagent back up on its own conversation and worktree after a usage limit or restart, with one opt-in setting.

doubt.pushback: No release notes or code link in the post.

items.title: TensorFold provider plugin published on ClawHub for OpenClaw
items.summary: An OpenClaw provider plugin starts a TensorFold server on demand or connects to a running one, so OpenClaw can use TensorFold-served models.
